cues.title: 用共振放大微弱响应
cues.titleEn: Amplify a weak response with resonance
cues.caption: 驱动频率接近共振频率时，金属棒的机械响应增强。
cues.zh: 韦伯尝试用大型金属棒响应引力波引起的微小形变，再用传感器转成电信号。驱动频率接近棒的共振频率，响应会增强。形变在画面里极度放大，数值仍按小应变模型计算。这里是装置原理示意，并不表示这根棒实际收到了引力波。
cues.en: Weber used large metal bars to seek tiny deformations from gravitational waves, converting motion into an electrical signal. Response increases near mechanical resonance. The drawing greatly magnifies deformation while the readout uses a small-strain model. It illustrates the proposed detector principle, not an actual detection.

cues.title: 共同出现，还要独立复核
cues.caption: 早期韦伯棒的探测宣称，没有获得独立实验确认。
cues.captionEn: Weber’s claim was not independently confirmed.
cues.zh: 把远处两个探测器的信号放到一起，是排查局部干扰的方法之一，但相似波形本身还不够。下方两条曲线人为加入共同的阻尼振动和不同背景，用来说明比较方法。韦伯早年的引力波探测宣称没有被独立证实，不能把这段科学史讲成引力波已经被发现。
cues.en: Comparing separated detectors can help reject local disturbances, but similar traces are not enough. These curves deliberately combine a common damped oscillation with different backgrounds to explain the method. Independent experiments failed to confirm Weber’s early claims. This history must not be presented as an established gravitational-wave discovery.

cues.title: 把脉冲星当作计时信号
cues.titleEn: Use a pulsar as a timing signal
cues.caption: 轨道运动改变脉冲到达间隔，连续计时约束双星轨道。
cues.zh: 双星中的脉冲星提供反复到达的射电信号。它沿视线靠近和远离时，脉冲到达间隔发生周期变化。图中两星按偏心轨道绕质心运动，底部周期来自视线速度的低速多普勒近似。它只说明计时原理，真实脉冲星分析还包含传播、引力和参考系校正。
cues.en: A pulsar supplies repeated radio pulses. As it approaches and recedes along the line of sight, arrival intervals change periodically. The stars follow eccentric barycentric orbits and the plotted period uses a low-speed Doppler approximation. Real timing also corrects propagation, gravity and reference-frame effects.

cues.title: 每一圈略早，几十年会怎样？
cues.titleEn: A little earlier each orbit: what accumulates?
cues.caption: 周期略短，近星点更早到达。
cues.captionEn: Shorter periods make periastron arrive earlier.
cues.zh: 这些点来自已发表的脉冲星计时记录。横线表示轨道周期不变的参考。为什么测得的到达时刻越来越早？引力辐射带走能量，轨道结合得更紧，间距减小，每圈时间就更短。金色曲线是论文另外给出的广义相对论预测。先想一想，后来的记录应该靠近哪条线？现在揭开原有的后段观测点。这里累计提前约一分钟，并不是每圈的周期缩短了一分钟。它来自许多次很小的提前，是射电计时提供的间接证据。
cues.en: These are published pulsar timing records. The horizontal reference assumes an unchanged orbital period. Why do arrivals become earlier? Radiation carries away energy, leaving a more tightly bound, smaller orbit with a shorter period. The gold line is the paper’s separately published general-relativity prediction. Which line should the later records approach? Now reveal those original observations. About a minute of accumulated early arrival does not mean that each orbit became a minute shorter. Many tiny advances add up. Radio timing supplies indirect evidence.

cues.title: 跟光走一趟，再看合成
cues.titleEn: Follow the round trip, then combine the fields
cues.caption: 光程差改变回程相位，合成光场决定读出。
cues.zh: 先跟着同一束光：分成两路，遇到端镜返回，再汇合到探测器。这里用较大的教学位移和明确的偏置工作点，把原理看清。一臂伸长，另一臂缩短，往返光程不同，两路返回光的相位就错开。合成的波改变，探测器的光强也改变。先预测：如果两臂一起等量伸长呢？相位一起变，相对差不变，差分信号为零。反转差分位移，偏置读出的变化也反向。回到真实量级，四千米光臂的差分只有四阿米，相位变化约四点七二乘十的负十一次方弧度。真实LIGO还需要光学腔、反馈和校准。
cues.en: Follow one beam: split it, reflect both parts from the end mirrors, then recombine them at the detector. Larger teaching displacements and an explicit biased operating point make the mechanism visible. Opposite arm changes alter round-trip path difference, shifting the returning phases. Their summed field changes the detected power. Predict what happens if both arms lengthen equally. Both phases change together: their difference, and the differential signal, stay unchanged. Reverse the differential motion and the biased signal reverses. At the physical scale, four-kilometre arms differ by just four attometres, a phase change of roughly four-point-seven-two times ten to the minus eleven radians. Real LIGO adds optical cavities, feedback and calibration.

cues.title: 两站真实记录，保留各自的噪声
cues.titleEn: Two real records, with their independent noise
cues.caption: 两站记录可比较，但不是同一条理论曲线的复制。
cues.captionEn: Two real signals retain different noise.
cues.zh: 现在看二零一五年九月十四日的真实记录，已按论文的方法滤波。两站的波形相近，细小噪声却各不相同。为了叠放比较，官方图把汉福德记录前移七毫秒，并按两站的相对朝向反号。观察前后几个周期：后面的间隔更短。致密双星失去轨道能量，间距减小、绕转加快，旋近的引力波频率随之上升。这里的轨道模型用于解释，不是重新拟合事件。回到记录，利文斯顿先收到信号；论文测得的时差约六点九毫秒。两站一致性还要结合仪器检查和噪声统计，不能只凭一段相似波形宣布发现。
cues.en: Now inspect the actual records from September fourteenth, twenty fifteen, filtered as in the paper. Similar waveforms retain different noise. For comparison, the official plot moves Hanford’s record seven milliseconds earlier and reverses its polarity for the detectors’ relative orientation. Compare early and late cycles: the later spacing is shorter. A compact binary loses orbital energy, moves closer and orbits faster, increasing the inspiral-wave frequency. This separate orbit model explains the trend; it does not refit the event. Back in the records, Livingston received the signal first. The paper reports a delay of about six-point-nine milliseconds. Consistency also needs instrument checks and noise statistics; similar traces alone do not establish a discovery.
